title: Negotiation & Relationship Money Skills 🤝
description: Salary negotiation, appraisal talk, partner/family financial dynamics, aur boundary setting.

cards.title: Salary Negotiation Rules 💼
cards.content:
First offer mat accept karo! Negotiation is expected.

Rule 1: Market rate research karo (Glassdoor/AmbitionBox).
Rule 2: Pehle number quote mat karo — "As per industry standard for my skill level".
Rule 3: Counter offer with 15-20% margin.
Rule 4: Variable + ESOPs + Perks consider karo total CTC mein.
cards.imagePrompt: Handshake across negotiation table with floating percentage badges, gold theme

choiceData.scenario: HR ne ₹6 LPA offer kiya. Tumhari market research ₹8 LPA batati hai. Reaction?

choices.text: Immediately Accept — darr hai offer cancel na ho jaye
Counter with data: ₹8.5 LPA based on skill & market benchmark
choices.consequence: Smart! Professional counter leads to ₹7.5 - ₹8 LPA settlement.

cards.title: Money Boundaries with Friends 🛡️
cards.content:
Dost paas aae aur loan maange? How to handle without breaking friendship:

1. Rule: Family/Friend ko vahi paisa do jo 'gift' samajh sako.
2. "Abhi mera budget locked hai SIP aur Emergency Fund mein".
3. Clear return date fix karo writing mein.
cards.imagePrompt: Shield with heart and handshake symbol, gold and amber illustration

quizData.question: Dost ke kehne par apne naam par EMI ya credit card loan lena chahiye?
quizData.explanation: Strict NO! CIBIL record aur financial liability tumhare naam aayegi.

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Prepare Appraisal Pitch
cards.content:
